title: How to Send a Vehicle RFQ to Japan That Gets a Useful Answer
description: The six pieces of information that help a Japan-side sourcing desk give you a faster, more accurate answer instead of vague stock lists.
content:
A vague request such as 'Toyota wanted' usually creates a vague answer. A strong RFQ lets a Japan-side buyer check the right route quickly and prevents wasted time on vehicles that can never meet your customer's requirement.
1. Exact model and gradeInclude the exact model, grade, drivetrain, engine, transmission, body type and any mandatory options when they matter. For customer orders, specify what is non-negotiable and what is flexible.
2. QuantityOne customer-order vehicle and a recurring stock requirement are different commercial jobs. State the quantity you need now and whether repeat demand is likely.
3. Target buying price and currencyTell us whether the target is the Japan vehicle price, total Japan-side payable amount, FOB, or another basis. A number without its price basis can create a false comparison.
4. Destination country or portDestination affects export eligibility, documentation, age rules, standards and cost assumptions. Even when you arrange shipping yourself, the destination still matters to route verification.
5. Required timingASAP, this month and a specific delivery deadline are different. Timing helps determine whether current stock, dealer sourcing, auction sourcing or another route is appropriate.
6. Used-vehicle condition requirementsFor used or premium vehicles, include registration year, maximum mileage, allowed colors, repair-history rules, auction grade, interior grade and any condition points that are mandatory.
Example of a useful RFQMercedes-Benz GLE 350d Coupe, 2019 or 2020 only, one unit, under 40,000 km, auction grade 4.5, interior A, no black or blue, target JPY 4.2M Japan-side vehicle price, shipping arranged by buyer, required as soon as possible.
What happens nextJPNentry uses the RFQ to verify the exact Japan-side route and current cost. We do not ask you to replace your existing supplier. We can simply act as an additional route when your regular source cannot fill a specific order.

title: How JPNentry Works: One Request → Verified Japan Route → Quote
description: Send one exact requirement. JPNentry verifies the Japan-side route, obtainable quantity, current cost and key conditions before preparing a specific quote.
content:
JPNentry is built for buyers who already know what they need from Japan — or can describe one exact requirement.
The simple flow
* 1. Send the exact item, model, JAN, MPN, OEM part number or vehicle specification.
* 2. Include quantity, destination and target buying budget when available.
* 3. We verify the Japan-side route, current cost, obtainable quantity and relevant conditions.
* 4. If the route is commercially workable, we prepare a specific quote.
* 5. Procurement starts only after the exact scope, approval and payment conditions are clear.
What we do not do
We do not turn a public listing into a stock promise. We do not invent allocation, savings, delivery dates or importability.
Have one live requirement?
Send one exact request. That is the fastest way to see whether JPNentry can create value for your business.

title: How to Buy from Japan Safely: 5 Checks Before You Pay
description: Before paying for goods from Japan, confirm the exact item, real sourcing route, obtainable quantity, current cost and condition, and transaction-specific terms.
content:
The safest sourcing process is not the one with the biggest catalogue. It is the one that verifies the exact transaction before money moves.
Five checks
* Confirm the exact product, part or vehicle specification.
* Confirm there is a real Japan-side route for that exact requirement.
* Confirm the obtainable quantity — one retail listing does not prove scalable supply.
* Confirm current cost, condition and lead time.
* Confirm the commercial and payment terms before procurement.
JPNentry's rule
If a material fact is not verified, we treat it as unknown rather than presenting it as confirmed.

title: Want a Japan Sourcing Quote? Send These 5 Things
description: A useful Japan sourcing quote starts with five facts: exact item, identifying reference, quantity, destination and timing or target budget.
content:
You do not need to send a long introduction. A clear requirement is more useful.
Send these 5 things

* JAN, MPN, OEM part number, SKU, model code or product URL when available
* Quantity
* Destination country or port
* Timing and target buying budget/currency when available
Why this matters
The more exact the requirement, the faster we can verify whether there is a real Japan-side route and whether the economics make sense.
Ready?
Send one current requirement. We will verify before quoting rather than guessing.

title: Japan Sourcing FAQ for Overseas Buyers
description: Straight answers about JPNentry sourcing, quotes, stock verification, service fees, procurement, shipping and what happens when a requirement is already quote-ready.
content:
Do I need to pay a research fee before every quote?
No. If your exact product/model, quantity, destination and commercial details are already sufficient for a normal quote, we can route it as a quote-ready RFQ.
Does JPNentry guarantee stock?
No. Availability, allocation, final price, delivery timing and exportability are only stated when verified for the actual transaction.
Can you work as a backup Japan source?
Yes. You do not need to replace your current suppliers. One of the best use cases is a difficult, urgent or specific requirement where an additional Japan-side route helps.
What should I send first?
One exact requirement: item/model/reference + quantity + destination + target budget when available.

title: JPNentry Buyer Protection: Our Non-Negotiable Sourcing Rules
description: The operating rules JPNentry uses to reduce sourcing mistakes: no invented stock, no forced substitutions, no procurement without a clear gate and no pipeline metrics presented as completed sales.
content:
The fastest way to lose trust in cross-border sourcing is to promise what has not been verified.
JPNentry therefore uses a small set of non-negotiable operating rules. They may make us slower than a seller who says yes to everything. They are designed to make the transaction more defensible.
* No stock claim without current evidence.
* No exact-availability claim from a generic or outdated listing.
* No forced substitution. A different model, grade, condition or SKU requires buyer approval.
* No procurement merely because a research fee was paid.
* No payment screenshot treated as matched funds without a clear identity, amount and currency match.
* No quote presented as revenue and no prospect presented as a client.
* No buyer name, logo or testimonial used publicly without the required permission.
* No hidden assumption that product price includes shipping, duties, taxes or third-party fees unless the quote explicitly says so.
What this means for a buyerYou should be able to see what is known, what is still being checked, what the current commercial scope includes, and what decision is required next. If a route cannot be supported by evidence, JPNentry should not make it sound certain.
Ready to test the process with one requirement?

title: What Happens After You Pay JPNentry
description: A transparent step-by-step view of what JPNentry does after a sourcing service payment is matched, from intake through evidence-backed sourcing and the next commercial decision.
content:
Payment starts work. It does not automatically authorize a product purchase.
JPNentry separates the paid sourcing service from the later purchase of goods. That protects both sides from rushed procurement, mismatched items and unsupported promises.
1. We match the paymentWe verify the buyer identity, service, currency and amount. A screenshot alone is not treated as matched funds.
2. We match the intakeWe connect the payment to the actual requirement. If one material detail is missing, we ask for that detail instead of guessing.
3. We run the purchased Japan-side scopeThe work depends on the tier purchased: focused search, deeper multi-channel sourcing, or broader project-start research and coordination.
4. We verify evidence before making commercial claimsA retail listing is not automatically scalable B2B supply. Before a buyer-facing candidate or quote is relied on, JPNentry checks the evidence relevant to that transaction — such as exact specification, supplier route, current price, quantity, seller authority and practical procurement path.
5. We separate the next decisionIf a viable route exists, the next step may be a goods quotation or procurement proposal. If the route is weak or unavailable, we say so. The sourcing fee does not guarantee stock, final price or successful procurement.
6. Procurement only begins after the commercial gate is clearThe exact item, buyer approval, matched funds for the relevant purchase, verified route and required commercial checks must align before JPNentry treats procurement as authorized.

title: JPNentry Proof Standard: What We Count — and What We Do Not
description: The public evidence standard JPNentry uses so leads, replies, quotes, supplier checks and live pipelines are never presented as completed customer outcomes.
content:
JPNentry Proof Standard
Trust is easier to damage than to build. JPNentry therefore uses a public proof standard for every metric, case note and milestone it publishes.
Four proof classes
* Execution Metric — work actually performed, such as verified outreach, replies or qualified sourcing actions.
* Live Pipeline — an open commercial opportunity, quote, RFQ or buyer requirement that has not yet become a completed transaction.
* Infrastructure — a system, checkout, operating control or workflow that is live and usable, but is not itself customer traction.
* Completed Outcome — a verified commercial milestone such as paid, procured, shipped, delivered or repeat order, supported by matching transaction evidence.
Publication rules
* Every public number must have an internal evidence source.
* Open quoted value must be labelled quoted/open and never described as revenue.
* Buyer names are not published without a clear reason and appropriate permission; live sourcing examples are anonymized by default.
* Supplier stock is not claimed from a retail listing alone.
* A first payment, shipment or repeat order becomes a separate completed milestone rather than being mixed into prospecting statistics.
* Old metrics are refreshed or retired instead of silently remaining on the site indefinitely.
The standard we are aiming for
A prospective buyer should be able to tell the difference between what JPNentry has built, what JPNentry is actively working on, and what JPNentry has already completed. That distinction is part of the product.

title: Founder Background: Japan-Based Cross-Border Operating Experience
description: Founder background that explains the operating experience behind JPNentry, clearly separated from JPNentry client results and sourcing transaction claims.
content:
Founder Background
JPNentry is operated from Japan by Masato Nishio. The founder background below is presented as operating experience — not as JPNentry client results.
Building and operating across Japan and Asia
Before launching JPNentry, Nishio built and operated Riot Basketball Academy, a separate youth-development organization. Its 2026 partnership materials record 4,000+ U8–U15 players coached across Japan and Asia.
The same materials document activity across multiple Japanese regions including Sendai, Kawasaki, Yamagata, Akita, Kobe, Saga, Okinawa and Ishigaki, alongside international activity and relationships involving Germany, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan and Korea.
Why this background is relevant
* Operating from Japan while coordinating people and partners across regions and countries
* Cross-border scheduling, communications and relationship management
* Building repeatable operating systems rather than relying only on ad-hoc introductions
* Working across Japanese and international communication contexts
* Managing programs where trust depends on accurate logistics, follow-through and expectation setting
Important separation
Riot Basketball Academy and JPNentry are separate activities. The 4,000+ player figure is not a JPNentry client count, the international basketball relationships are not presented as JPNentry buyer or supplier relationships, and no sports credential is used as proof of sourcing inventory, vehicle supply or market-entry outcomes.
The relevance is operational: JPNentry is being built by a Japan-based operator with prior experience coordinating multi-location and international activity, and that experience informs the discipline behind the current sourcing and market-entry systems.

title: How JPNentry Verifies Japan-Side Sourcing Before Quoting
description: JPNentry separates public availability from real commercial supply and checks the evidence that matters before making buyer-facing claims.
content:
A Japan marketplace listing is useful evidence, but it is not automatically a commercial supply route.
What we verify
* Exact product, part, model or vehicle specification
* Supplier or seller route
* Current price and compulsory Japan-side costs
* Obtainable quantity or replenishment potential
* Condition and lead time where relevant
* Commercial, payment and export conditions where relevant
Why buyers use this approach
It reduces the risk of receiving a quote built on assumptions that disappear when the buyer is ready to proceed.
